name: anylark
description: Bridge Feishu/Lark group chats to local agent sessions (pi / Claude Code / Codex)

scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/core packages/adapter-pi packages/adapter-claude packages/adapter-codex packages/daemon packages/channel-feishu packages/ui packages/cli
scripts.test:unit: node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning --test $(find packages/core/test packages/daemon/test packages/cli/test packages/ui/test packages/channel-feishu/test -name '*.test.ts' | sort)
